description: This file defines the OrderItem class within the Order aggregate in the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It models items within an order, including details about the catalog item ordered, unit price, and quantity.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents an item in an order, including a reference to the ordered catalog item, its unit price, and quantity.

methods.name: OrderItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize an OrderItem with specified catalog item, unit price, and units.
